t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice explained that gnomes consistently carry the same coloured basket, so for example, red gnome, red basket. It didn't specifically indicate any decisions I should take when there is a "5x" multiplier, but advised that when I find a gnome with a higher yield on a "1x", I should continue selecting gnomes with the same coloured basket until I notice the yield go under 3. So essentially, when I find a reasonable yield for "1x", I should repeat the choices I'm making until the situation changes.

vb_textbox.text: On the screen where you hit spacebar to collect mushrooms, you'll notice that the basket displayed is either red or yellow. During the game, there are periods where yellow baskets result in higher yields, and periods where red baskets result in higher yields.  Selecting a red, purple or brown gnome always results in a red basket displaying, while selecting yellow, blue and green gnomes results in a yellow basket displaying: It might help to remember this like warmer colours = red basket, cooler colours = yellow basket. When you start, note the number of mushrooms you get and the colour of the basket. If you got 3+ on the 1x multiplier or 15+ on the 5x multiplier, stick with the gnomes that result in this colour basket for the time being. If you see these numbers going under 3/15, switch to gnomes resulting in the other colour of basket.
